lines.en: I glide on the airstream.
My wings barely beat.
I fly fastest between the stone peaks.
The wind is the road I take.
I skim over your head.
My tail feathers trail a white line.
I ride the updraft in circles.
I do not land; landing slows me.
I am looking for the next one.
One wingbeat: ten blocks.
I come down out of the cloud.

lines.zh: 石头被我带起的风吹动
lines.en: The stone stirs in my wake.
I hold still in midair.
The wind holds me without effort.
My feathers tremble slightly.
I am listening to the valley wind.
These peaks are mine to patrol.
It is very quiet up here.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在找移动的东西
lines.en: My eyes hunt for movement.
I rest on a current.
Below is too close; I stay up here.
The wind carries my cry away.
I watch you from above.
You are small, but easy to spot.
No one hides from me on these peaks.
My eyes reach farther than an eagle's.

lines.zh: 你抬头时我已经转了半圈
lines.en: I had already circled once when you looked up.
You are standing in my current.
I regard you as I would a stone.

lines.zh: 你的火把在这里很扎眼
lines.en: Your torch stands out here.

lines.zh: 我不用低头就能看见你
lines.en: I see you without lowering my head.
I do not cry; the wind does.
A few tail feathers fell.
This wound will not stop flight.
I climbed higher.
Your arm is strong.
I circle to recover.
The wind is holding me up.
Again; I have not landed.
I do not eat what lies on the ground.

lines.zh: 你举着它，以为我会下来
lines.en: You hold it up, thinking I will descend.
There is another scent on the wind.
The wind holds me as I circle it once.
Dropped food would break apart.
What I want is your position.
What I smell is iron, not meat.
I will not land for a mouthful.
Set it on the stone first.
You hit the wind I stirred up.
The impact nudged me aside.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞到我的羽尾
lines.en: Your shoulder met my tail feathers.
I withdrew to higher air.
A gust pushed us apart.
I was barely affected.

lines.zh: 你的护甲刮出一声长响
lines.en: Your armor dragged out a long scrape.
Two feathers fell.
This height does not welcome you.
Do not stand at the wind's mouth.

lines.zh: 凤凰的伴侣烧起来才出现
lines.en: A phoenix's mate comes only through fire.
I belong to the wind; I keep no nest.
You have no standing to ask.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛不是给你碰的
lines.en: My feathers are not for you to touch.
This current holds only one.
I will not descend for anyone.
Solitude is the price of flight.
Looking up at me is enough.
I need no companion while circling.
The wind carries such thoughts away.
I never land to pick things up.
That is not mine.

lines.zh: 我用爪子抓过东西，不轻
lines.en: My talons have gripped things; not gently.
It fell into a rock crevice.
I dive; the wind arrives first.
I hook it with a talon.
This is useless for flight.
I drop it back to you.
Catch it; do not drop it.

lines.zh: 下坠的东西我都看得见
lines.en: I see everything that falls.
I pin you with my eyes.

lines.zh: 你站在空旷处，很难错过
lines.en: Standing in the open, you are hard to miss.
The wind is just right for this.
I begin from above.
Looking up at me is already too late.
There is no cover on these peaks.
My shadow reaches you first.
I chose you because you move.
A long cry is the start.
Do you hear the wind rising?
I do not fold my wings when I dive.
You will remember this height.
I circle once only to aim.

lines.zh: 从这里到地面只要两秒
lines.en: From here to the ground: two seconds.
You carry nothing that stops wind.
I come from beyond the ridge.
I circle above your head.
Wherever you run, you stay in my sight.
I use the current to speed up.
You hid in a crevice.
I wait at the crevice mouth.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀投下的影子在移
lines.en: My wing's shadow moves across the ground.
Do you hear the wingbeats?
I fly along the ridge.
The peaks will answer for you.
The more you hide, the more exposed you are.
I have no need to slow down.
The wind turned; I am faster.
You stopped. Good.
I fold my wings before the dive.

lines.zh: 你的位置每时每刻都清楚
lines.en: Your position is clear at every moment.
There are no blind spots from up high.
I have been descending all along.
You looked up too late.
My talons land first.
This strike carries wind.
You are flung backward.
One dive was all I needed.
My feathers sweep your face.
I roll above you.
The wind pressure unsteadies you first.
My talon tips are hard.
That was only a probe.
I never touched the ground.
You are pushed toward the rock wall.
My wing strikes your shoulder.
I pull up and come again.
You carry a few pale marks now.
The second will be truer.
The wind put out your torch.
I come from behind.
This circle is over.
I come down out of the clouds.
A shadow joins the peaks.
You hear the wind before you see me.
I appear circling.

lines.zh: 山脊上站着一只风的形状
lines.en: A shape of wind stands on the ridge.
My long cry fills the valley.
This airspace is mine.

lines.zh: 我从石缝上面的气流里升起
lines.en: I rise out of the current above the crevices.
You look up; I am already there.
Feathers fall before you know.
I sweep past at your height.

lines.zh: 我从远处的地平线飞来
lines.en: I come from the far horizon.
Fire is no stranger to a phoenix.

lines.zh: 我被迫下坠，翅膀撑住了
lines.en: I was forced down; my wings held.
Water is too heavy; I cannot rise.
The blast wave flipped me.
An arrow grazed my wing bone.
The spell snared my wind.
Long flights leave me hollow.
Lightning and wind are kin.
There is no current here.
